title: A New Chapter Begins: Salama Estates and salamaestates.com Are Now for Sale
summary: After careful consideration, we have made the difficult decision to offer Salama Estates and salamaestates.com for sale. We are seeking the right buyer who recognizes the potential of the brand and its digital identity and is ready to take it into its next chapter. Interested parties are invited to contact us directly via WhatsApp to discuss this opportunity.
quote: “Every brand has a story, and every ending creates an opportunity for a new beginning. We are ready to pass the torch and give Salama Estates the opportunity to grow under new ownership.”

sections.heading: An Important Announcement from Salama Estates
sections.body:
Some decisions are never easy, especially when they involve something built with dedication, ambition, and a vision for the future.

Today, we are sharing an important announcement with our community, visitors, and potential business partners. After careful consideration, we have decided to put Salama Estates and its domain, salamaestates.com, up for sale.

This decision comes with mixed emotions. Letting go of a brand is never simply a business transaction; it also means closing one chapter and creating the possibility for another. While we are sorry to see this chapter come to an end, we believe the time is right to explore new opportunities and find a new owner who can take the brand forward.

We are now welcoming inquiries from serious buyers, entrepreneurs, investors, and real estate professionals who are interested in acquiring Salama Estates.

sections.heading: An Opportunity for a New Owner
sections.body:
We believe that the right buyer may see an exciting opportunity in the Salama Estates name and its associated domain.

Whether you are an established real estate company looking to expand your digital presence, an entrepreneur preparing to launch a property business, or an investor exploring potential acquisitions, we invite you to consider this opportunity.

The sale offers an opportunity to acquire the Salama Estates brand identity together with the domain name salamaestates.com, subject to the final agreed terms of the transaction.

A memorable name and a dedicated domain can form part of a business's digital foundation. Under new ownership, Salama Estates could represent the beginning of a fresh vision, a new strategy, and a different direction for the future.

We are not simply looking to transfer ownership. We hope to connect with a buyer who understands the potential of the opportunity and is ready to take the next step.

sections.heading: Why We Have Decided to Let Go
sections.body:
Every business journey reaches moments when important decisions must be made. For us, this is one of those moments.

Although it is difficult to say goodbye, we recognize that moving forward sometimes means allowing someone else to continue a journey in a new way. We believe that Salama Estates deserves the opportunity to find a new home and potentially develop under fresh leadership.

We are grateful for the journey that has brought us to this point, and we look forward to finding the right buyer who sees value in what is being offered.

Our intention is to approach the sale professionally, communicate openly with interested parties, and work toward a suitable agreement with the successful buyer.

sections.heading: What Is Included in the Sale?
sections.body:
The opportunity centers on the acquisition of Salama Estates and the domain name salamaestates.com.

Interested buyers are encouraged to contact us directly to discuss the scope of the sale, the assets included, the asking price, and the proposed transfer arrangements.

Any additional business assets, intellectual property, website content, accounts, or other items will need to be confirmed as part of the discussions and final agreement.

We welcome genuine inquiries from individuals and organizations interested in exploring the acquisition and learning more about the available opportunity.

sections.heading: Interested in Acquiring Salama Estates?
sections.body:
If you have been looking for a brand and domain that could become part of your next business venture, we invite you to get in touch.

We are open to discussing the opportunity with serious potential buyers and answering questions about the sale process. Whether you are ready to make an offer or would first like to understand the details, we welcome you to contact us directly.

Contact us on WhatsApp

WhatsApp Number: +974 5510 2655

Direct WhatsApp Link: https://wa.me/97455102655

Please mention that your inquiry relates to the acquisition of Salama Estates and salamaestates.com so we can direct the conversation accordingly.

We look forward to connecting with prospective buyers and exploring the possibilities ahead.

sections.heading: A Final Word: Every Ending Is a New Beginning
sections.body:
It is never easy to let go of something that has been part of your journey. However, we believe that new beginnings often emerge from difficult decisions.

As we prepare to pass Salama Estates and salamaestates.com into new hands, we hope to find a buyer who sees the opportunity, embraces the possibilities, and is ready to write the next chapter.

Thank you to everyone who has taken an interest in Salama Estates. We look forward to hearing from prospective buyers and finding the right path forward.

Salama Estates and salamaestates.com are now available for acquisition.

For inquiries and further information, contact us today via WhatsApp at +974 5510 2655.

title: Platform Launch Initiative: Building the Largest Property Marketplace
summary: As part of our mission to create a comprehensive and trusted real estate marketplace, we have introduced a temporary property data acquisition strategy to provide users with meaningful and valuable content from day one.
quote: A marketplace is only valuable when visitors can find properties.

sections.heading: Newsroom: Platform Launch Initiative
sections.body:
As part of our mission to create a comprehensive and trusted real estate marketplace, we have introduced a temporary property data acquisition strategy to provide users with meaningful and valuable content from the first day of launch.

Many newly established property platforms face a common challenge: limited listings and insufficient market visibility during their early stages. To address this challenge, our platform currently displays accurate property information gathered from publicly available real estate sources.

This initiative allows visitors to browse properties, evaluate the market, and experience the platform while we continue building a growing community of property owners, real estate agents, landlords, developers, and agencies.

sections.heading: Why Are We Displaying Imported Property Listings?
sections.body:
Our objective is simple:

“A marketplace is only valuable when visitors can find properties.”

Without property listings, users may leave the platform before discovering its potential. To provide immediate value, we have imported publicly available property information from trusted real estate sources.

This approach helps us:

✅
Populate the marketplace with real property opportunities.
✅
Improve the user experience across search and browsing.
✅
Encourage immediate adoption by buyers and tenants.
✅
Attract property owners, agencies, and landlords.
✅
Build trust through useful, transparent, and relevant content.
✅
Create an active, buzzing marketplace experience from launch day.

sections.heading: Data Quality & Accuracy
sections.body:
We understand that accuracy is critical in the real estate industry.

For this reason, the data displayed on our platform is collected from publicly available listings and undergoes validation processes before publication whenever possible.

The goal is to ensure visitors have access to useful and reliable information while our direct listing ecosystem continues to grow.

sections.heading: Transparency First
sections.body:
We believe users deserve complete transparency regarding the source of information.

Some listings currently displayed on our platform may have been obtained from publicly available property websites.

While the information is generally accurate, some listings may contain:

Whenever possible, users should verify critical information directly with the corresponding property owner, agent, or agency.

sections.heading: The Future Vision
sections.body:
Moving To A Fully Community-Driven Marketplace

The current approach is temporary.

Our long-term vision is to build a platform powered entirely by property owners and real estate professionals.

As our user base grows, imported listings will gradually be replaced by listings created directly by verified users.

Future contributors will include:

Property Owners: Post and manage properties directly with real-time status control.
Real Estate Agents: Create professional listings and manage qualified inquiries.
Agencies: Maintain large property portfolios from a centralized dashboard.
Developers: Promote new housing projects, off-plan units, and launch developments.

sections.heading: Coming Soon
sections.body:
Verified Agency Accounts: Professional verification badges and dedicated profiles for certified real estate agencies.
Direct Listing Portal: Intuitive wizard to create, publish, and manage property listings instantly.
Property Performance Analytics: Detailed metrics to track property views, user engagement, and customer inquiries.
Lead Management Tools: Direct messaging and inbox management to communicate safely with potential buyers and tenants.
Premium Listing Features: Boost visibility in search results and reach high-intent home seekers faster.

sections.heading: Why Post Directly Instead?
sections.body:
Imported listings help us build the marketplace today, but direct listings provide a much better experience for both owners and seekers.

Key benefits include:

Complete Property Information: Add rich descriptions, detailed amenities, floor plans, and technical specifications.
Better Visibility: Reach more potential buyers and renters with featured placement.
Real-Time Updates: Update availability, pricing, and open-house hours instantly without delays.
Direct Enquiries: Receive enquiries straight into your dashboard from qualified clients.
Rich Media Support: Upload high-definition photos, virtual tours, walkthrough videos, and documents.
Performance Insights: Understand viewer demographics and see exactly how your listings perform.

title: Salama Estates Cybersecurity & Security Monitoring Policy
summary: Salama Estates maintains a comprehensive cybersecurity and security monitoring framework designed to protect residents, staff, properties, information systems, and community facilities. Our approach combines access controls, security monitoring, system logging, incident detection, and appropriate physical security measures to identify and respond to unauthorized access, suspicious activity, and potential security incidents.
quote: Protecting our communities means protecting both the people who live in them and the information and systems they rely on.

sections.heading: Cybersecurity Program Overview
sections.body:
Salama Estates operates a cybersecurity program designed to protect company systems, property-management platforms, resident information, business records, connected devices, and other technology resources.

Security controls are implemented according to the sensitivity of the information and systems involved. These controls may include strong authentication, access restrictions, encryption, security updates, endpoint protection, network monitoring, backups, and administrative controls.

Access to Salama Estates systems is provided according to job responsibilities and business requirements. Personnel are expected to use company systems responsibly and must not attempt to bypass security controls or access information without authorization.

sections.heading: Security Monitoring & System Logs
sections.body:
Salama Estates maintains security logs and monitoring capabilities to help identify unauthorized access, suspicious activity, system failures, and potential cybersecurity incidents.

Depending on the system, security logs may record events such as authentication attempts, successful and unsuccessful logins, account changes, administrative activity, system alerts, access to protected resources, network security events, and other relevant security information.

Security logs are reviewed through automated alerts, security monitoring tools, and authorized personnel. Monitoring is performed for legitimate security, operational, compliance, and incident-response purposes.

Log access is restricted to authorized personnel with a legitimate business or security requirement. Logs may be retained for an appropriate period based on legal, regulatory, operational, and security requirements.

sections.heading: Unauthorized Access & Trespassing Detection
sections.body:
Salama Estates uses appropriate physical and technological security measures to help identify unauthorized access to controlled areas and property.

Depending on the location and applicable requirements, security measures may include access-control systems, entry records, security cameras, alarms, visitor-management systems, security personnel, and other monitoring technologies.

When an unauthorized person is detected in a restricted area, relevant security information may be reviewed to establish what occurred, when the event occurred, which access point or system was involved, and what response is appropriate.

Security personnel and authorized management may review relevant access records and surveillance information when investigating suspected trespassing, unauthorized entry, property damage, theft, or other security incidents.

Monitoring does not replace emergency services or law enforcement. Where an incident presents an immediate threat to people or property, appropriate emergency procedures will be followed.

sections.heading: Identity & Access Management
sections.body:
Access to Salama Estates systems, facilities, applications, and sensitive information is controlled according to the principle of least privilege.

Users receive only the access required to perform their authorized responsibilities. Access rights may be reviewed periodically and should be removed or modified when an individual's role changes or access is no longer required.

Administrative accounts receive additional protection because they can provide elevated access to systems and security configurations.

Where supported, Salama Estates may use multi-factor authentication, strong password requirements, account monitoring, device controls, and other authentication safeguards.

sections.heading: Security Alerts & Incident Response
sections.body:
Potential security incidents may be identified through automated alerts, system logs, access-control events, CCTV systems, reports from employees or residents, security personnel, or other monitoring mechanisms.

Examples of incidents include suspected unauthorized access, compromised accounts, malware, suspicious network activity, unauthorized entry, tampering with security equipment, theft, vandalism, or attempts to circumvent security controls.

When an incident is identified, Salama Estates may investigate the available evidence, contain the incident, protect affected systems or property, preserve relevant records, and take appropriate corrective action.

Where required, incidents may be escalated to management, security personnel, service providers, insurers, legal representatives, regulators, or law enforcement authorities.

sections.heading: Protection of Security Logs and Evidence
sections.body:
Security logs, access records, video footage, alerts, incident reports, and other security evidence are protected against unauthorized access, alteration, or disclosure.

Where appropriate, security records may be preserved as part of an incident investigation. Access to such records is restricted to authorized personnel with a legitimate need to review them.

Information collected during an investigation is handled responsibly and only used for legitimate security, operational, legal, compliance, or investigative purposes.

sections.heading: Privacy & Responsible Security Monitoring
sections.body:
Salama Estates recognizes that effective security monitoring must be balanced with respect for privacy and applicable laws and regulations.

Monitoring activities are intended to protect people, property, systems, and information. Salama Estates seeks to limit collection and access to information to what is reasonably necessary for legitimate security and operational purposes.

Personal information and security records are handled according to applicable privacy requirements and internal policies. Security information is not made publicly available simply because it has been collected for monitoring purposes.

sections.heading: Security Review & Continuous Improvement
sections.body:
Salama Estates periodically reviews its cybersecurity and physical security controls to identify opportunities for improvement.

Security practices may be updated in response to emerging threats, changes in technology, security incidents, regulatory requirements, operational changes, and lessons learned from previous investigations.

The objective is to maintain a security environment that continuously improves the protection of Salama Estates communities, properties, people, information, and technology.
